description.zh:
主域名名称。域名名称。<props="china">可通过调取[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调取[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>

域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

- PUBLIC：权威域名（默认值）

- CACHE：权威代理域名
description.en:
The type of the domain name. The parameter value is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

*   PUBLIC (default): hosted public domain name
*   CACHE: cache-accelerated domain name

description.zh:
查询的结束时间，格式：**YYYY-MM-DD**。

默认为查询当天的时间。
description.en:
The end date of the query. Specify the end date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.

The default value is the day when you query the data.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh（默认）：中文
- en：英文
指主机记录，如果要解析www.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写www。
description.en: The hostname. If you want to resolve www.dns-exmaple.top, set Rr to www.

description.zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：**YYYY-MM-DD**。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90`。

若查询时间小于等于7天，按照`维度：小时`返回数据，即：`StartDate <= Now - 7`。

若查询时间大于7天，按照`维度：天`返回数据，即：`StartDate > Now - 7`。
description.en:
The start date of the query. Specify the start date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.

You can only query the DNS records within the last 90 days.``

If the time range is less than or equal to seven days, data is returned on an hourly basis.````

If the time range is greater than seven days, data is returned on a daily basis.````

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-record-statistics --lang en --start-date 2019-07-04 --end-date 2019-07-04 --domain-name exmaple.com --rr www --domain-type PUBLIC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeRecordStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2019-07-04' --Rr www --DomainType PUBLIC --DomainName 'exmaple.com' --Lang en --EndDate '2019-07-04'
